title: Regime Structure and Entropic Flow Ontology in Discrete Gravity Models
abstract: Formalizes the regime structure of discrete entropic gravity across three regimes: UV/Newtonian, IR/MOND-like, and Cosmological/Yukawa. Demonstrates the dual role of the cosmological constant, acting as the MOND acceleration scale a_0 locally and setting the cosmological length scale L_Lambda ~ 4.4 Gpc globally.

efc_context.regime_relevance: Three-regime structure (UV/Newtonian, IR/MOND-like, Cosmological/Yukawa) with Lambda dual role

key_results: Three discrete gravity regimes: UV/Newtonian, IR/MOND-like, Cosmological/Yukawa
Cosmological constant dual role: a_0 locally and L_Lambda ~ 4.4 Gpc globally
Formal ontology for entropic flow across regime boundaries
Interpolating function connecting discrete regime sectors
